meta.name: competitive-research-snapshot
meta.description: Research a competitive landscape with cited snapshots, a comparison matrix, and so-what implications. Use when a product decision needs competitive grounding, not a market report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速生成竞品对比矩阵与行动建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做产品决策前需要快速了解竞品格局
copy.tagline_en: Generate competitive comparison matrix and actionable insights quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick competitive grounding before product decisions

howto.what: Claude 会把竞争研究变成固定流程：先给搜索计划，选3-4个重点对手，把信息逐条标为“事实/推断/假设”并附来源URL，最后产出对比矩阵与“所以呢”决策含义，格式稳定可重复比对。
howto.when: 当你的请求是为了产品决策找竞争依据（不是要行业市场报告）时触发，例如重新定位、路线图取舍、核查销售为何输给对手等场景。

say.text: 给我们的报销自动化产品做竞争快照，决策：Q1 应该优先做哪个路线图功能。
say.note: 它会确认未填的竞对项，然后给出搜索计划。

say.text: 帮我看清销售总输给的那个竞对，找出他们真实的强项和弱点，用于打单话术。
say.note: 会把证据标为事实或推断，并附来源URL。

say.text: 只分析我们指定的三家竞对，输出对比矩阵和两条产品机会，别做市场报告。
say.note: 产出会标注置信度并给出后续步骤选项。

howto.what_en: Runs as a fixed workflow: search plan first, 3-4 selected competitors, findings labeled Fact/Inference/Assumption with source URLs, then a comparison matrix and so-whats.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a product decision needs grounded competitive evidence, not a market report; e.g. repositioning, roadmap trade-offs, or reviewing why sales loses to a rival.

say_en.text: Competitive snapshot for our expense product: which Q1 roadmap feature should win?
say_en.note: It asks for missing competitors, then shows the search plan.

say_en.text: Real strengths and weaknesses of the rival we lose deals to, for sales.
say_en.note: It labels evidence as fact or inference, with URLs.

say_en.text: Three listed competitors: matrix + two product opportunities, no market report.
say_en.note: It labels confidence and offers next-step options.
